presentation.name: Product details available when the page first loads
presentation.description: Can search and AI tools read the product details without running scripts or clicking anything?
presentation.improve: Publish the product details in the page’s initial text so tools can read them without clicking or waiting for scripts.
presentation.fullCredit: Substantive main-product content is delivered in the initial HTML without JavaScript execution or interaction.

presentation.name: Product information available as readable text
presentation.description: Can people and tools read the product information as text rather than only in images or hidden data?
presentation.improve: Provide the product information as readable page text.
presentation.fullCredit: Delivered product information is ordinary extractable text.

presentation.name: Clearly identified product content
presentation.description: Can tools distinguish this product from navigation, reviews and other products?
presentation.improve: Clearly distinguish the audited product content from other page content.
presentation.fullCredit: The audited product content is distinguishable from navigation, recommendations, reviews and other products.

presentation.name: Product information tied to the selected option
presentation.description: Are displayed values reliably associated with the selected option?
presentation.improve: Associate displayed product values with the correct selected option.
presentation.fullCredit: Displayed values are reliably associated with the selected configuration.

presentation.name: Accessible supporting information
presentation.description: Are referenced specifications, guides and policies accessible?
presentation.improve: Provide readable sections or usable links to relevant specifications, guides and policies.
presentation.fullCredit: Referenced specifications, guides and policies are accessible as readable sections or usable links.

presentation.name: Product data readable by search tools
presentation.description: Is the product information for search tools written in a valid, recognized format?
presentation.improve: Correct formatting errors in the product data so search and AI tools can read it.
presentation.fullCredit: Relevant product markup parses and uses recognized types, properties and value formats.

presentation.name: Product record identifies the right item
presentation.description: Does the information supplied to search tools clearly identify the product on this page?
presentation.improve: Make the product record supplied to search tools clearly identify the product being assessed.
presentation.fullCredit: A Product entity unambiguously represents the audited product page.

presentation.name: Price and stock linked to the right option
presentation.description: Are price, currency and availability linked to the correct product or selected option?
presentation.improve: Connect the verified price, currency and availability to the correct product or option.
presentation.fullCredit: Offers connect to the appropriate Product or variant with internally coherent price, currency and availability fields.

presentation.name: Valid product identification codes
presentation.description: Are applicable manufacturer or global product codes valid and linked to the correct product or option?
presentation.improve: Publish verified manufacturer or global product codes where applicable and link them to the correct product or option.
presentation.fullCredit: Applicable external identifiers have valid formats and correct product or variant associations.

presentation.name: Product options connected correctly
presentation.description: Can search tools connect each size, colour or other option to the main product and its distinguishing details?
presentation.improve: Connect each product option to the main product and identify the details that distinguish it.
presentation.fullCredit: Parent products, variants and their distinguishing attributes are correctly connected.

presentation.name: Product name agrees across the page
presentation.description: Do the visible product details and the product record describe the same item and option?
presentation.improve: Make the product name and option agree in the visible content and product record.
presentation.fullCredit: Same product and variant agree

presentation.name: Price agrees across the page
presentation.description: Do the visible price and the price supplied to search tools agree for the same option?
presentation.improve: Match the current price and currency across the visible page and product record.
presentation.fullCredit: Price and currency agree in same context

presentation.name: Stock availability agrees across the page
presentation.description: Does the availability shown to visitors agree with the product record?
presentation.improve: Match the availability across the visible page and product record for the same option.
presentation.fullCredit: Availability agrees in same context

presentation.name: Product claims agree across the page
presentation.description: Do product claims agree wherever they appear in the visible content and product record?
presentation.improve: Review the cited claims and make their meaning and scope consistent.
presentation.fullCredit: Supplied claim groups agree

presentation.name: Clear page title and product heading
presentation.description: Do the page title and main heading clearly identify the product?
presentation.improve: Use a clear page title and main product heading that identify this product.
presentation.fullCredit: Specific title and main product heading

presentation.name: Clear headings and specification labels
presentation.description: Are product details organised under clear headings with readable labels?
presentation.improve: Group the relevant details under clear headings and label the specifications so shoppers can find them.
presentation.fullCredit: Clearly labeled sections and readable specifications

presentation.name: Useful product image descriptions
presentation.description: Do informative product images have useful text descriptions for people and tools that cannot see them?
presentation.improve: Give each informative product image an accurate text description. Verify which images need a change in the evidence below.
presentation.fullCredit: Useful alternatives for informative images

presentation.name: Access for search engines
presentation.description: Does the website allow the search engines checked by this audit to access this product page?
presentation.improve: Review the website’s crawler permissions and decide which search engines should be allowed to access the product page.
presentation.fullCredit: Both search crawlers allowed at product URL

presentation.name: Access for AI answer tools
presentation.description: Does the website allow the AI retrieval tools checked by this audit to access this product page?
presentation.improve: Review the website’s crawler permissions against the AI tools you want to allow.
presentation.fullCredit: All listed retrieval crawlers allowed

presentation.name: Working website sitemap
presentation.description: Can the audit find and read a sitemap that helps tools discover the website’s pages?
presentation.improve: Publish a readable sitemap containing the relevant website pages.
presentation.fullCredit: Retrievable parseable sitemap or index with relevant children

presentation.name: Product included in the sitemap
presentation.description: Does the website’s sitemap include the product page assessed here?
presentation.improve: Include the correct product URL in a readable sitemap.
presentation.fullCredit: Audited or legitimate canonical URL listed

presentation.name: Website identity in the AI guide
presentation.description: Does the website’s llms.txt guide identify the business or website?
presentation.improve: If you maintain an llms.txt guide, identify the business and website clearly.
presentation.fullCredit: Meaningful llms.txt identifies site and purpose

presentation.name: Useful links in the AI guide
presentation.description: Does the llms.txt guide link to useful website resources?
presentation.improve: If you maintain an llms.txt guide, add verified links to the relevant product, category or information pages.
presentation.fullCredit: Useful working catalog and policy or help links

presentation.name: Website context for AI tools
presentation.description: Does the website’s agent guide explain what the business and website provide?
presentation.improve: If you maintain an agent guide, describe the business and the purpose of its website.
presentation.fullCredit: Meaningful site-specific agent guide

presentation.name: Clear guidance for AI tools
presentation.description: Does the website’s agent guide give tools useful instructions for using its information?
presentation.improve: If you maintain an agent guide, add clear, accurate instructions and links that help AI tools use the website’s information.
presentation.fullCredit: Practical authoritative references

presentation.name: Product identity
presentation.description: Does the page clearly identify the product, brand and model where applicable?
presentation.improve: Provide the verified product identity, including brand and model where applicable.
presentation.fullCredit: Specific product identity and applicable brand and model

presentation.name: Specific product explanation
presentation.description: Does the description explain this product in useful, specific terms?
presentation.improve: Explain the product’s relevant features and benefits with concrete, verified details.
presentation.fullCredit: Clear complete explanation of product and function

presentation.name: Options and included items explained
presentation.description: Does the page explain the product’s configurations and what is included?
presentation.improve: Describe the available configurations and included items clearly.
presentation.fullCredit: Clear selected configuration and included items

presentation.name: Essential product details
presentation.description: Does the page provide the essential details shoppers need for this type of product?
presentation.improve: Provide the essential product details identified by the findings, including units and scope where needed.
presentation.fullCredit: Every applicable essential attribute explicit with required units and scope

presentation.name: Additional useful product details
presentation.description: Does the page include the additional details that help shoppers choose and use this product?
presentation.improve: Add the supporting product details identified by the findings using verified information.
presentation.fullCredit: Every applicable supporting attribute explicit with required units and scope

presentation.name: Purchase price explained
presentation.description: Is the price clear for the product and option being assessed?
presentation.improve: Clarify the price, currency and any conditions for the selected option.
presentation.fullCredit: Price, currency and material conditions clear

presentation.name: Stock information explained
presentation.description: Does the content clearly explain the selected option’s availability?
presentation.improve: Publish current, option-specific availability information.
presentation.fullCredit: Availability for selected configuration clear

presentation.name: Shipping cost and delivery details
presentation.description: Can shoppers understand the applicable shipping cost and delivery information?
presentation.improve: Provide verified shipping costs, delivery information and the conditions that apply.
presentation.fullCredit: Coverage, cost or calculation and delivery guidance clear

presentation.name: Returns policy explained
presentation.description: Can shoppers understand the return window, eligibility and important conditions?
presentation.improve: Make the applicable return window, eligibility and conditions clear.
presentation.fullCredit: Eligibility, window and material conditions clear

presentation.name: Questions about product use answered
presentation.description: Does the page answer the relevant questions about how and when to use the product?
presentation.improve: Answer the product-use questions identified in the findings with specific, verified information.
presentation.fullCredit: Applicable category questions answered specifically

presentation.name: Compatibility questions answered
presentation.description: Does the page answer the relevant questions about what the product works with?
presentation.improve: Explain relevant compatibility requirements and restrictions.
presentation.fullCredit: Applicable category questions answered specifically

presentation.name: Product limitations explained
presentation.description: Does the page explain relevant limitations and situations where the product is unsuitable?
presentation.improve: Describe the relevant limitations and conditions identified in the findings.
presentation.fullCredit: Applicable category questions answered specifically

presentation.name: Help choosing the right option
presentation.description: Does the page help shoppers choose the appropriate size, fit or other product option?
presentation.improve: Add verified guidance that helps shoppers choose the correct option.
presentation.fullCredit: Applicable category questions answered specifically

presentation.name: Consistent product facts
presentation.description: Do comparable product facts agree within the same product and option?
presentation.improve: Resolve the conflicting facts identified in the findings and verify the correct value.
presentation.fullCredit: No detected contradiction with sufficient comparable evidence

presentation.name: Evidence for product claims
presentation.description: Are important product claims supported or clearly qualified?
presentation.improve: Support the cited claims with relevant evidence or explain the conditions and limits.
presentation.fullCredit: Material claims have relevant support or qualification
